system.description:
Only a creature with a feature that grants one (Combat Reflexes, or a monster ability that says so) makes Attacks of Opportunity; the feature says what provokes it, and Disengaging always prevents it. Being moved by someone else (a shove, a push, a throw) or teleporting never provokes one, unless the ability causing it says so.

Press Use to attack with your weapon, out of turn (once per round).

activities.name: Attack of Opportunity
activities.text: Once per round, out of turn: one melee attack against a creature that provokes it (the feature that grants it says what does; Disengaging always prevents it).
